prompt: Using PDB entry 5EDM, show the annotated helix that carries the wild-type residue at the position of the F2 (Prothrombin) missense variant p.L609P (likely pathogenic in ClinVar) as a teal cartoon, with that residue as cyan ball-and-stick.

grounding.text:
PDB 5EDM: Crystal structure of prothrombin deletion mutant residues 154-167 ( Form I )
Method: X-RAY DIFFRACTION, 2.20 Å
Polymer chains (author chain [label chain]; observed residues as author numbering = label numbering):
  A [A]: entity 1 (Prothrombin), protein, 550 of 568 residues observed: auth 1-242 = label 1-242; auth 261-568 = label 261-568
UniProt mapping (SIFTS; observed residues as UniProt numbering = author numbering):
  A [A]: P00734 (THRB_HUMAN): UniProt 44-196 = auth 1-153; UniProt 211-299 = auth 154-242; UniProt 318-622 = auth 261-565

From the request:
  F2: UniProt P00734 (THRB_HUMAN, Prothrombin)
  p.L609P: UniProt position 609 (Leu in UniProt) -> in 5EDM: auth A 552 LEU (label A 552)
  Helix annotated in the entry that contains that residue: auth A 552-567 (label A 552-567)

checks: target (1 residue(s), 8 atoms, residue name(s) LEU = the wild type) is the same atom set by three routes on the frozen atom table: label numbering from the frozen variant file, author numbering as written in the MVS reference, and the frozen SIFTS lookup of the UniProt position
the helix range is the same atom set in author and in label numbering and contains the target residue

the task accepts the cartoon style (ligands, ions and water gone) and the default view (all drawn), so an answer may also set hide_water, hide_heteroatoms, hide_carbs, hide_non_standard: with each, every accepted list still draws the target atoms as before (scripts/api_forms.py)
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 = 1, target score 1), and so does every accepted alternative
the twin on the other track selects the same target atoms
graded what the number in the variant's name selects when taken at face value as the author residue number (wrong) and as the label residue number (wrong); recorded under clinical.difficulty

clinical.api_note: pdbe-molstar resolves uniprot_accession + uniprot_residue_number itself (SIFTS), so this API task tests knowing that selector and supplying the accession; its MVS twin tests doing the UniProt-to-structure mapping.
